edits.before: U werkt in een grote winkel. De winkel krijgt een nieuw kassasysteem en er is een cursus van twee dagen. U wilt die cursus graag volgen, maar uw leidinggevende wil alleen de teamleiders sturen. U hoort eerst uw leidinggevende. Overtuig haar dat u de cursus ook moet volgen. Noem twee redenen en reageer op haar bezwaar. Sluit af met een vraag of een voorstel.
edits.after: U werkt in een grote winkel. De winkel krijgt een nieuw kassasysteem en er is een cursus van twee dagen. U wilt die cursus graag volgen, maar uw leidinggevende wil alleen de teamleiders sturen. U hoort eerst uw leidinggevende. Overtuig haar dat u de cursus ook moet volgen. Noem twee redenen en reageer op haar bezwaar.
edits.reason: Doubt 1, spec option "or drop C2/C3": the official middellang act is "convince with two reasons"; C0-C2 realise it and answer the cue. A fixed closing question or proposal is a generic extra the official content score does not reward, so feedback would call an answer incomplete that the exam scores in full. Dropping it removes a third narrated instruction sentence. Three criteria remain (checker minimum); time was not the reason (a four-criterion minimal answer is about 33 words).

author_doubts_decisions.1_announce_or_drop: Dropped C3 (the closing question or proposal) in cursusverzoek and verwarming-verhuurder, and kept C2. These tasks did not ask too much for the time; the reasons are exam shape and narration. Each cued middellang task keeps one criterion that answers the cue, so examentips and sollicitatietips keep their C3.
author_doubts_decisions.2_either_or_announcements: Kept: they mirror the criteria and offer a plain route for learners who do not know "geruststellen".
author_doubts_decisions.3_examentips_overlapping_quotes: Kept the author's quotes[1]: it shows two distinct tips, overlap is allowed and quotes are not learner-facing.
author_doubts_decisions.4_brandalarm_C0_quote: Accepted: the loosened C0 is the required fix, and quotes[0] meets it.
author_doubts_decisions.5_afvalcontainers_alt: Kept "'s avonds": the drawing reads as evening, and C1, which the judge also receives, names both times.
author_doubts_decisions.6_sportabonnement_model: Kept: "De Brug is wel vijftien euro goedkoper" is Zuid's drawback in comparative form, which matches the prompt and its "Vergelijk".
author_doubts_decisions.7_situation_links_and_fietskeuze_sample: Kept both. The criteria are visible and the situation supplies the facts. The sample never names Roos's circumstances; the audit run's disagreement is judge leniency of the same kind as on cursus-engels and werktelefoon. A robust alternative, should future runs keep disagreeing, is to rebuild the sample with the null at C3.
author_doubts_decisions.8_prompt_length: Acceptable. The longest is cursus-engels at 70 words, plus seven words over the base.
author_doubts_decisions.9_noem_minstens_twee_punten_removed: Accepted: the prompts now name their points, so the visible criteria and the narrated prompt say the same thing.
